title: Matte Black Towel Bar, 30-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Straight Bar, Concealed Mount, Que New, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Matte Black, towel bar for bathroom use, 30 inches / 30-inch / 30in wall mount straight bar made of solid brass, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs. Use as a towel bar, towel rack, towel holder, or towel rail to keep bath towels organized while saving space with a wall-mounted design. Center-to-center: 30 in. Bar diameter: 0.5 in. Overall depth: 33 in; height: 3 in. Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean finished appearance; includes towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4"). Weight capacity: 10 lb. Traditional/transitional look with dramatic circular detailing—fits transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware, including grooved bathroom hardware. Limited lifetime warranty. Part of the que new collection for matching que new coordination. Allied Brass Que New.
